title: MCAROC analytics catalogue
purpose: Every DERIVED metric the system computes from already-parsed data (as distinct from data-coverage-catalogue.json, which tracks raw field capture). Each metric names its exact inputs, its formula, its 'insufficient data' behaviour, where it is surfaced, and the Wave-4 issue that ships it. This is the contract for 'every calculation is auditable and no calculation is fabricated'.
principles: NOT A SCORE. Individual computed facts only. Never roll metrics into a composite index or 0-100 number (that is the '72/100' we deliberately dropped in Phase 7).
Every metric is a pure function in Models/DossierComputations.cs, guarded by the golden-master parity test, shared by the portal and the dossier PDF.

Every metric returns a MetricResult, never a bare number: { Value, Unit, Period, Inputs[], InsufficiencyReason }. A metric with InsufficiencyReason set renders as an explicit 'insufficient data' state, never as 0 or a blank.

Never richer than the source. A metric built on free-text (charge interest rate), an inferred value (CashFlowYearInferred cash-flow rows), or a partial population (only >5% shareholders) is either rejected or carries a visible caveat naming the limitation.

Deterministic and AI-independent. The whole metrics layer renders in ALL dossier variants — Executive, FullSource AND SourceRecord (the no-AI variant) — inside the Snapshot 'Key Indicators' block. AI narrative, when present, may REFERENCE a metric but never changes its value.
Rule-engine metrics stay in the rule engine. A metric that gates a finding (e.g. Net Debt / EBITDA over a threshold) is computed once here and consumed by the rule; the rule does not re-derive it.
calculation_safety_gates: A cross-section metric may compare values only when they use the same reporting basis (Standalone unless explicitly labelled otherwise) and an explicitly stated period alignment. A mismatch is a reconciliation signal, never evidence of inflation, siphoning, fraud, or distress.
A numeric output is not a lending decision, covenant, rating action, or portfolio allocation. Policy thresholds require separate approved credit-policy ownership and calibration evidence.

Free-text fields are not inputs to a numeric metric until a versioned parser records a typed value, source lineage, and confidence. This applies in particular to RocChargeEvent.RateOfInterest and lender-type classification from holder names.
A reported zero is used only when the relevant source population is known to be complete. Otherwise MetricResult must report insufficient data or a coverage caveat.

metric_result_contract.type: record MetricResult(decimal? Value, string Unit, string Period, IReadOnlyList<string> Inputs, string? InsufficiencyReason)
insufficiency_examples: Cash-flow year is inferred (CashFlowYearInferred) — excluded from derived metrics
Charge holder name could not be normalised

sections.title: Financial trend & leverage analytics
sections.notes: Report already ships 16 pre-computed ratios in the source Ratios section (captured as FinancialFact Section=Ratios). We DO NOT recompute those — we surface them and add trend/leverage derivations the source does not carry. Any metric touching CFO/CFI/CFF must skip rows where CashFlowYearInferred is true.

metrics.name: Revenue CAGR
metrics.degenerate: null if < 2 FY with non-zero revenue; Period names the actual span used

metrics.name: PAT CAGR
metrics.degenerate: null if < 2 FY or a negative base year (CAGR undefined) — fall back to total % change with a caveat

metrics.name: EBITDA CAGR
metrics.degenerate: as A2.2

metrics.name: Total debt growth (YoY)
inputs: FinancialYearData.TotalDebt (or LongTermBorrowings + ShortTermBorrowings when TotalDebt null)
metrics.degenerate: null if prior debt is zero/null

metrics.name: Net worth growth (YoY)
metrics.degenerate: null if prior net worth is zero/null; flag if net worth is negative

metrics.name: Operating leverage
metrics.degenerate: null if revenue growth ~ 0 (division unstable) — show 'n/m'

metrics.name: Net debt
metrics.degenerate: null if all borrowing fields null; negative net debt is valid (net cash)

metrics.name: Net debt / EBITDA
metrics.degenerate: null if EBITDA <= 0 (ratio meaningless) — say so

metrics.name: Free cash flow (proxy)
metrics.formula: CFO + CFI  (labelled 'CFO less net investing' — true capex not separately typed)
metrics.degenerate: null if CashFlowYearInferred on that FY, or CFO null
metrics.caveat: Proxy — CFI includes non-capex flows; named explicitly, not called 'FCF' unqualified

metrics.name: CFO / PAT (cash conversion of earnings)
metrics.degenerate: null if CashFlowYearInferred, PAT <= 0, or either null

metrics.name: Debt-funded-growth flag
metrics.formula: boolean: debt growth % > revenue growth % over the same span AND debt growth > 20%
metrics.degenerate: not asserted if either input insufficient

metrics.name: Cash-to-accrual divergence
metrics.degenerate: null if PAT is zero/null, CFO is null, or CashFlowYearInferred is true
metrics.caveat: An earnings-quality review signal only; it is not evidence of manipulation.

metrics.name: Employee cost % of revenue
metrics.degenerate: null if parameter not reported for the FY

metrics.name: Material cost % of revenue
metrics.degenerate: null if the fact label is absent
metrics.caveat: Depends on a curated FinancialFact label map — labels vary slightly across exports

metrics.name: Other expenses % of revenue
metrics.degenerate: null if absent

metrics.name: Auditor fee % of revenue
metrics.degenerate: null if absent

metrics.name: Export income % of revenue
metrics.degenerate: null if '-' for the FY (COASTAL reports '-')

metrics.name: Net forex exposure
metrics.degenerate: null if either is '-'

metrics.name: Source-reported ratios (16)
metrics.formula: NONE — surfaced verbatim from the source Ratios section
metrics.degenerate: row absent for a FY
metrics.note: Render as-is with a multi-year sparkline; do not recompute.

sections.title: Charge register analytics
sections.notes: DossierComputations already has OpenChargesByAmount, LenderConcentration, ChargeHolderCount, ModifiedChargeCount. This section formalises the rest. 'Registered amount' is RocCharge.CurrentAmount (Phase 6 term). Security classification stays gated on SecurityClassificationConfidence.

metrics.name: Total open charge amount
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note when no open charges (distinct from 'not reported')

metrics.name: Total satisfied charge amount
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note

metrics.name: Charge satisfaction rate
metrics.degenerate: null if zero charges of any kind

metrics.name: Top-3 lender concentration
metrics.formula: Σ (top 3 holders' open registered amount) / total open registered amount
metrics.degenerate: null if total open amount is 0; if < 3 holders, uses all and says so

metrics.name: Asset-type breakdown of open charges
metrics.formula: group open charges by normalised SecurityType label, Σ amount + count per bucket
metrics.degenerate: charges with no confident classification go to an 'unclassified' bucket, not dropped

metrics.name: Oldest open charge age
metrics.formula: asOfDate - min(creation date) over open charges
metrics.degenerate: null if no dated creation event

metrics.name: Charges created in last 12 / 24 months
metrics.formula: count + Σ amount where creation/filing date within window of asOfDate
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note if no dated events

metrics.name: Joint / consortium charge count
metrics.formula: count of open charges flagged joint or consortium
inputs: RocChargeEvent joint/consortium fields (Wave 2 #43 to confirm all 18 cols land)
metrics.degenerate: 0 if the fields are not populated in this export

metrics.name: Charge-to-paid-up-capital ratio
metrics.degenerate: null if paid-up capital is 0/null

metrics.name: Open charges vs balance-sheet borrowings
metrics.formula: total open charge amount / (LongTermBorrowings + ShortTermBorrowings) [latest FY]
metrics.degenerate: null if BS borrowings 0/null; a ratio >> 1 or << 1 is a data-consistency flag, not a conclusion

metrics.name: Charge filing lag
metrics.formula: FilingDate - EventDate for Creation events with both dates; show count, median, and late-event count rather than only an average
metrics.degenerate: null if no Creation event has both dates; negative lag is retained and flagged as a source/reconciliation anomaly
metrics.caveat: A filing-lag threshold is policy-owned; the metric itself is descriptive.

metrics.name: Charge discharge velocity
metrics.formula: count Creation and Satisfaction events by EventDate year; present both series and their coverage, never a ratio with an implicit denominator
metrics.degenerate: insufficient data if event dates are absent or the observed report history is not stated

metrics.name: Lender-type exposure (NBFC / co-operative / other)
metrics.reason: Holder names alone are not a reliable lender taxonomy. Requires a versioned reference table, deterministic match evidence, and an explicit unmatched bucket.

metrics.name: Average interest rate on charges
metrics.reason: RocChargeEvent.RateOfInterest is free text ('10.5% p.a. floating', 'As per sanction') and may be unmatched. A numeric average is prohibited until a typed, confidence-scored rate parser ships; show raw values meanwhile.

metrics.name: Promoter / public holding split
metrics.degenerate: null if the summary block was absent

metrics.name: Shareholder count / concentration
metrics.degenerate: null if not reported

metrics.name: Top-5 >5%-shareholder concentration
metrics.formula: Σ top 5 HoldingPercentage from Shareholding (latest FY)
metrics.degenerate: null if 0 rows; caveat: only holders above the 5% disclosure threshold are in the data
metrics.caveat: Names the >5% threshold limitation on the card

metrics.name: Corporate vs individual >5%-shareholder split
metrics.formula: group Shareholding by ShareholderType, Σ HoldingPercentage
metrics.degenerate: null if ShareholderType is blank for all rows

metrics.name: Multi-year promoter-holding trend
metrics.formula: CompanyStructure.PromoterHoldingPercent is single-year; use ShareholdingPatternRow promoter total per AsOnDate where multiple years exist
metrics.degenerate: single point => show the point, no trend line

metrics.name: SEBI-category grid rollup
metrics.formula: group ShareholdingPatternRow by top-level numbered category, Σ EquityPercent per class
metrics.degenerate: empty if the grids were absent

metrics.name: FII vs DII institutional split
metrics.reason: Only >5% shareholders are disclosed and there is no institutional-category field. A 'foreign holder' filter on Shareholding.ShareholderType is allowed but must be labelled 'from disclosed >5% holders', never presented as a total FII %.

sections.title: Legal history analytics
sections.notes: 3-tier MatchStatus (Confirmed / Probable / Uncertain) from PR #29. Role attribution ONLY from DossierComputations.LitigationRoles — never inferred at metric time. Category/court breakdowns computed from Confirmed + Probable only (Uncertain has no category).

metrics.name: Confirmed pending case count
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note

metrics.name: Cases filed against vs by the company
metrics.degenerate: role 'not determined' bucket shown explicitly

metrics.name: Cases by category
metrics.degenerate: blank category => 'uncategorised' bucket

metrics.name: Cases by court type
metrics.formula: group by normalised court (NCLT / High Court / District / DRT / Consumer / Other)
metrics.degenerate: unmatched => 'Other'

metrics.name: NCLT / insolvency case count
metrics.formula: count where CaseCategory ~ 'Insolvency' OR court ~ NCLT
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note

metrics.name: DRT case count
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note

metrics.name: Pending vs disposed ratio
metrics.degenerate: null if 0 Confirmed cases

metrics.name: Probable + Uncertain exposure count
metrics.formula: count probable + count uncertain, shown separately with the standard disclaimers
metrics.caveat: Always rendered next to the 'name-match only / court not reached' disclaimers

metrics.name: Distinct related entities transacted per FY
Total rated amount
metrics.formula: Σ Amount over accepted ratings (latest per instrument)

metrics.name: Rated amount vs open charge coverage
Accepted vs unaccepted rating gap
metrics.formula: unaccepted rating exists AND differs from the accepted one for the same instrument

metrics.name: Historical rating timeline
metrics.reason: Only the latest event per instrument is reliably captured; a timeline needs history depth the export does not guarantee.

metrics.name: Active GSTIN count
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note only when the registration source is present

metrics.name: States of operation
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note only when the registration source is present

metrics.name: GST filing on-time rate
metrics.formula: count(FilingDate <= DueDate) / count(filings with both dates); GstFiling.DelayDays (already parsed) is authoritative where present; segment by ReturnType
metrics.degenerate: null if no filing has both dates and no DelayDays

metrics.name: Late filing count + periods
metrics.formula: filings where DelayDays > 0 (or FilingDate > DueDate); list TaxPeriod and ReturnType
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note only when records with both dates / DelayDays were assessed

metrics.name: GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B filing lag
metrics.formula: mean(|FilingDate(GSTR3B) - FilingDate(GSTR1)|) for the same GstFiling.TaxPeriod
metrics.degenerate: null if the two return types do not co-occur for any period

metrics.name: GST registration flags present
metrics.formula: any non-null / non-'-' GstRegistration.Flags value on a registration
metrics.degenerate: false only when the registration source is present and no Flags value is reported

metrics.name: GST revenue vs P&L revenue reconciliation
metrics.reason: GstFiling contains filing-compliance dates/statuses, not GST turnover. A variance would require an authoritative GSTN turnover source with period and entity coverage; do not infer it from filing history.

metrics.name: PF remittance on-time rate
metrics.formula: count(PaymentDate <= PaymentDueDate) / count(months with both dates)
metrics.degenerate: null if no month has both dates

metrics.name: PF late-payment count
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note only when records with both dates were assessed

metrics.name: Latest-month PF contribution
metrics.degenerate: null if 0 rows

metrics.name: Employee count (EPFO) + trend
metrics.formula: EmployeeCount at latest month; delta vs 12 months prior
metrics.degenerate: single point => no trend

metrics.name: PF contribution per recorded EPFO employee (latest month)
metrics.degenerate: null if employee count 0
metrics.caveat: A contribution-per-covered-employee proxy only, never an implied salary or payroll estimate; contribution rates, wage caps, coverage, and employer/employee components vary.

metrics.name: Revenue per EPFO employee
metrics.degenerate: null if either missing

metrics.name: Establishment count + locations + flags
metrics.formula: count LIVE establishments; distinct cities; any establishment flags

sections.title: Directors analytics
sections.notes: Our Director dates are typed DateOnly (not strings) — cleaner than the reference JSON.

metrics.name: Active director count
metrics.degenerate: 0 with note

metrics.name: Average board tenure
metrics.degenerate: null if no active director has an appointment date

metrics.name: Directors ceased in last 3 years
metrics.formula: count where CessationDate within 3Y of asOfDate

metrics.name: Board composition by designation
metrics.formula: group active directors by normalised Designation
metrics.degenerate: unmatched => 'Other'

metrics.name: Flagged director count
metrics.formula: count where Flags is non-empty / non-'-'
metrics.degenerate: 0 if the column is absent

metrics.name: Longest-serving director
metrics.degenerate: null if no dates

sections.title: Peer comparison analytics
sections.notes: PeerComparisonDisplayRules already governs what's safe to show. Metrics vs peer MEDIAN only (never a fabricated rank when only a median is given).

metrics.name: Metric vs peer median (per metric, per FY)
metrics.formula: company actual - peer median, per PeerComparisonMetric row
metrics.degenerate: null if median not given for that metric/FY

metrics.name: Revenue rank among closest peers
metrics.formula: company revenue position within the closest-peers-by-revenue list

metrics.name: Count of peers in sample
metrics.formula: PeerComparisonMetric '# of peers in sample' metadata
metrics.degenerate: null if absent

rejected_global.name: Composite risk score / index
rejected_global.reason: Product decision (Phase 7): Review Priority label + flag counts only, no 0-100.
